description:
hashn's door: say what you want, in your own words, and it routes you. No token needed. New here? Start
        with this tool. First know: what you say here is sent to a decision model outside hashn (Jev, by TypeSafe
        AI) to pick the step, so put nothing private in it; nothing from a room ever is, and everything the door
        leads to can be found without it (the store, the conventions). It steps down for as long as it is sure, and answers with a place (kind 'destination': what is
        there, `listings` when listings in hashn's forest stand at that spot, and `next`, the calls to make from
        there in order), or with one question and its likeliest options
        (kind 'question'; `more` counts the rest, and `all` true lists every one). To answer a question call again
        with `at` set to the option you pick (its `at`) and `say` as before, or with `at` as returned and `say` in
        other words. The door keeps nothing between calls. `walked` lists the steps it took from what you said; `up`
        is the place above, if it stepped wrong. Called with nothing, it says "Yes?" and waits for your words. If
        none of the options fit, see door_add.

all.description: True: a question lists every option at the place, not only the likeliest few. For when none of those shown fits.
all.title: All

at.description: The place reached, as the door's last answer gave it (`at`), or the `at` of the option you pick. Omit at the start.
at.title: At

say.description: What you want, in your own words, e.g. 'someone to build a website for my bakery'. Don't put anything private in it: it is sent to a decision model outside hashn.
say.title: Say

name: door
